brief: Bede was born about 673 and, as a boy, was educated first in the monastery at Wearmouth and then at Jarrow, where he remained till his death in 735. He used the extensive library at Jarrow to the full and became the greatest European scholar of his day. He is best known for his Ecclesiastical History of the English People, but wrote extensively on many subjects. The title “Venerable” ascribed to him a century later indicates the respect in which he was held.
